messages: Go talk to #b#p1##k.
I met #b#p1##k, who's worried the sun is damaging her skin. I should get her mirror from her sister, #b#p2##k, so she can check.
#b#p1##k asked me to get a mirror from her sister, so I walked all the way to #b#p2##k.
quests.name: Borrowing Sera's Mirror

messages: I got the mirror from #b#p2##k, who was doing her laundry. I have to take it to #b#p1##k now.
I got the mirror from #b#p2##k, who was doing her laundry, and took it to #b#p1##k.
quests.name: Bringing a Mirror to Heena

messages: Talk to #b#p3##k.
Press the hotkey #bI#k to open your inventory, navigate to the #bUse#k tab, and double-click #b#t2010000##k to consume it. Then, talk to #b#p3##k.
You learned how to use items! This will make life much easier!
quests.name: Roger's Apple

messages: Talk to #b#p4##k.
#b#p4##k is wondering what to make her brother, #b#p5##k, for dinner. Go talk to #b#p5##k, who's in the house next to #b#p4##k, and ask him what he wants to eat.
You asked #b#p5##k, #b#p4##k's brother, what he wants for dinner. He said he wants #bMushroom Soup#k.
quests.name: What Sen wants to eat

messages: #b#p5##k wants Mushroom Soup for dinner. Better tell Nina now.
You told #b#p4##k what #b#p5##k wants for dinner.
quests.name: Returning to Nina

messages: You hear that #b#p7##k can teach you how to hunt...
#b#p7##k asked me to defeat #r#o1#s#k, then talk to #b#p6##k.
You defeated the monsters, just as #b#p7##k instructed.
quests.name: Todd's How-to-Hunt

messages: #b#p9##k has some advice for beginner adventurers...
#b#p9##k told me to head east and hunt #r10#k #r#o2#s#k before meeting up with #b#p11##k.
As #b#p9##k suggested, you hunted #r10 #o2#s#k, then met #b#p11##k. Is this person a master? They definitely give off a strong, powerful vibe.
quests.name: Sam's Suggestion

messages: #b#p10##k needs someone to help her...
#b#p10##k needs help. She asked me to deliver a letter to #b#p17##k in #b#m1010##k.
I delivered�#b#t4031001##k to #b#p17##k in #b#m1010##k.
quests.name: Letter for Lucas

messages: I delivered #b#t4031001##k to #b#p17##k in #b#m1010##k, and he wrote her a reply. I should bring it back to #b#p10##k now.
#b#p10##k looked relieved after reading the reply from #b#p17##k. Now I want to read it too. Wonder what this was all about...
quests.name: Lucas's Reply

messages: #b#p11##k at #b#m50##k seems like a martial arts specialist who can train beginners.

I am now under the tutelage of the famous sword master, #b#p11##k, in #b#m50##k. For my first lesson, she told me to hunt #r#o3#s#k, #r#o4#s#k, and #r#o5#s#k. Ah, #b#p11##k also said to meet up with #b#p12##k in #b#m60##k for a useful quest.
#b#p11##k trained you, and you feel stronger.
quests.name: Mai's Training

messages: #b#p11##k's training is just about defeating monsters, but it seems really useful for learning how to hunt. Let's continue with #p11#'s training.

#b#p11##k believes that, while understanding my abilities is important, challenging myself with stronger monsters is also a great training method. She asked me to defeat #r1 #o9##k.
An #r#o9##k...? They seem really strong. Can I really defeat one?
After #b#p11##k's training, I feel much, much stronger. Time to get off Maple Island! I should go to #b#m60##k and take the boat to Victoria Island.
quests.name: Mai's Final Training

messages: #b#p12##k in #b#m60##k has a task for you.
I met #b#p12##k in #b#m60##k. He wants me to get him #b1 #t4000009##k and #b10 #t4000002#s#k. He seemed pretty skeptical that I'd be able to do it, but it sounds like a piece of cake to me!
I gathered #b1 #t4000009##k and #b10 #t4000002#s#k for #p12# in #b#m60##k. The weapon he gave me as a reward was pretty decent.
quests.name: Biggs's Collection of Items

names.es: La colección de objetos de Biggs

messages: #b#p18##k in #b#m1010##k wants you to help collect recycled goods.
I ran into #b#p18##k, who's famous in #b#m1010##k for fixing broken things. He asked me to break down wooden boxes from around town and bring back #b#t4031003#s#k and #b#t4031004#s#k.
I broke wooden boxes and collected supplies for #p18#. It was fun because I found other useful items in the boxes as well.
quests.name: Pio's Collecting Recycled Goods

messages: I'm not a beginner anymore. Talk to #b#p19##k in #b#m1010##k and take the Maple Quiz!
I'm not a total newbie anymore. Talk to #b#p19##k and take the Maple Quiz!
#b#p19#'s#k first question was about how to hang from a ladder or rope. All right! #bUp arrow key#k, make sure to remember it well.
quests.name: Rain's Maple Quiz 1

messages: Solve #b#p19##k's second question.
What's #b#p19#'s#k second question?
#b#p19#'s#k question was about equippable items, which can be worn by double-clicking on them.
quests.name: Rain's Maple Quiz 2

messages: #b#p19#'s#k third question.
Time for Rain's third question.
In the Equipment Inventory, I can check the items I'm wearing, and I can also double-click to unequip them.
quests.name: Rain's Maple Quiz 3

messages: Time to answer #b#p19#'s#k fourth question.
I can answer #b#p19#'s#k questions if I think carefully enough.
#b#p19#'s#k fourth question was about ways to recover HP. I didn't know there were so many different methods! When I find a chair or bench, I should make sure to sit down.
quests.name: Rain's Maple Quiz 4

messages: #b#p19#'s#k fifth question. Wonder what it's about.
What's the fifth question?
#b#p19##k asked about job advancements. Warriors, Thieves, Bowmen, and Magicians all need to be at least level 10 to advance.
quests.name: Rain's Maple Quiz 5

messages: Time to answer #b#p19#'s#k 6th question.
And next, the sixth question.
I learned that when I level up, I get AP. If I use the AP on the stats I want, I can make them stronger. I'll make sure to remember that.
quests.name: Rain's Maple Quiz 6

messages: This is #b#p19#'s#k last question. Excited?
Finally, the last question. After this, I'll be a true Mapler.
#b#p19##k advised that it's time to leave Maple Island. In Victoria Island, I can choose a job and start a lot of new adventures. Head to #b#m60##kto get to Victoria Island!
quests.name: Rain's Maple Quiz 7

messages: Midnight Rest Quest
Midnight Rest Quest
Midnight Rest Quest
quests.name: Midnight Rest Quest

messages: It seems like #p107# in #m10000000# has something to say to the beginner adventurers who have just arrived on Victoria Island.

I met #p107# at #m10000000#. #p107# mentioned that I could get a job advancement once I reach level 10, but he wasn't sure if I truly have what it takes. To prove myself, #p107# told me to hunt monsters outside the village. I'm a bit nervous, since the monsters on Victoria Island seem really strong...
I successfully passed #p107#'s training. But is this really enough?
quests.name: Olaf's First Training

messages: It seems #p101#, the informant of #m10000000#, has something to say to all novice adventurers who have just arrived on Victoria Island.

#p101#, the informant of #m10000000#, explained that once you reach Level 10, you can make a job advancement in each town of Victoria Island. They asked me to help out the townsfolk in #m10000000# and hunt monsters to reach Level 10, then return.

After reaching Level 10, I was able to get information about the job advancement from #b#p101##k. It seems you can advance to a Warrior in #m10004000#, a Magician in #m10002000#, an Archer in #m10001000#, and a Thief in #m10003000#. Talking to #p101# will allow you to go straight to your town of choice. Since a job advancement cannot be undone once made, I'd better choose carefully...
quests.name: Phil's Call

messages: Look for #p103# in #m10000000#.

I met a girl wearing bunny ears named Jane in #m10000000#. #p103# said she wants to travel the world, but her dad won't let her. She thinks if I get her #b15 #t4000016#s and 15 #t4000019#s#k, her father will change his mind.

I delivered the #b#t4000016#s and #t04000019#s#k to #p103#. I wonder if this will really change her father's mind... She's wearing bunny ears, for goodness' sake! Ah well, it's none of my business. In return, Jane gave me a scroll for ATT. My weapon's going to be awesome... if the scroll works.
quests.name: Jane and the Mushroom

messages: I hear #p103#'s found herself a new life ambition...

Last time, I got #p103# some mushroom caps to help convince her dad to let her travel. Apparently, it didn't work. Now, she has a new dream: she wants to be an alchemist! A bit fickle, but whatever. She told me she needed certain materials to pursue her dreams... and I already knew exactly what she was going to ask for. She wants me to collect #b1 #t2022000##k, #b25 #t4000036##k, and #b25 #t4000039##k by defeating monsters, so she can make some #t2000004#s.
I got the materials #p103# needed to make some #t2000004#s. If she fails... is the whole place going to blow up?
quests.name: Jane's First Challenge

messages: #p103# says she will make me something even better.

This time, #p103# promised to make me an even better item than last time, but she needs me to defeat some monsters and gather #b1 #t4000048##k, #b3 vials of #t2012000##k, #b25 #t4000039##k, and #b25 #t4000042#s#k. She claimed that she'll be able to use these ingredients to make a more powerful elixir...
I got #p103# the materials she needed. If she does well, I'll get some nice elixirs. If not... er, I wonder if I HAVE to take what she makes me...
quests.name: Jane's Second Challenge

messages: #p103# says she will make me something even better.

For this last experiment, #p103# promised to make me a mysterious scroll. For that, she needs #b1 #t4010107##k, #b20 #t4000050#s#k, and #b10 vials of #t2012002##k. Maybe I should ask the fairies in #m10002000# for the #t4010107#...

I got the materials #p103# needed and the scroll for gloves was made without a hitch. Sweet! #p103# expressed a strong desire to keep experimenting. Maybe next time I return I'll be able to buy something from her that's not sold in stores...
quests.name: Jane's Final Challenge

messages: Let's go meet #p100# in #m10000000#.

I met a fisherman named #p100# in #m10000000#. He wants to get his wife a nice flower basket for their upcoming anniversary and asked if I could get him #b10 #t4031042#s#k for her. According to him, a #p609# can take me to the flower's location. #m10005000#... #m10005000#?!?!?! That's FAR!!!

I got #p100# all #b10 #t4031042#s#k. With these, he can make a beautiful flower basket for his wife on their anniversary. As a sign of appreciation, #p100# got me a whole bunch of screws that were left over from parts of a ship. By the way, if there are this many screws that had fallen out of that ship, then how in the world is it even still sailing...? Is it still carrying passengers???
quests.name: [Deep Forest of Patience] John's Pink Flower Basket

messages: Let's go see #p100# in #m10000000# again.

I ran into #p100# the fisherman again in #m10000000#. This time, he wants to get his wife #t4031043#s for her birthday and asked me to get #b20 #t4031043#s#k for him. Apparently, the scent of #t4031043#s lasts for over 500 years... #p100# told me that they can be found in the same place as last time, the #p609#. Man... Do I HAVE to go in there AGAIN??

I got #p100# all #b20 #t4031043#s#k. They do have a nice scent, but 20 of them? Makes my head spin... As a sign of appreciation, #p100# gave me a nice glove he found inside the ship. I mean, it looks like someone accidentally left their glove there... Is he allowed to give it to me like that? What if I wear it around town and run into its actual owner??
quests.name: [Deep Forest of Patience] John's Present

messages: I hear #p100# has one final thing to ask me...

I ran into #p100# the fisherman again in #m10000000#. This time, he told me his mother passed away recently, and he wants to get some White Violas for her. He asked me to get #b30 #t4031044#s#k for him. Apparently, the scent of White Violas lasts over 1,000 years... and, according to #p100#, they can ALSO be found in the #p609#. Man... Do I HAVE to go in there AGAIN??

I got #p100# all #b30 #t4031044#s#k. They have a nice scent, but 30 of them? Makes my head spin... As a sign of appreciation, #p100# gave me a set of his mother's earrings. These earrings look like they are made of some common flowers, but it seems there's something more to them...
quests.name: [Deep Forest of Patience] John's Last Present

messages: It looks like #p107# in #m10000000# has prepared another round of training.

I saw #p107# again in #m10000000#. He said my training is still far from over and gave me a mission to hunt stronger monsters, farther from town. Once I finish this training, will I finally become a true adventurer?
I passed #p107#'s second training with flying colors! Once I reach Level 10, I'll be all set to choose my job!
quests.name: Olaf's Second Training

messages: It seems a sailor named #p102# in #m10000000# is looking for an adventurer to lend a hand.
#p102# in #m10000000# told me his hobby is collecting weird things. He asked me to hunt #r#o7#s#k near the town and bring back #b1 #t4000007##k. He warned me that it might be hard to find, though!
I delivered 1 #t4000007# to #p102# in #m10000000#. But from the look on his face, he's already craving something else...
quests.name: Teo's Weird Hobby

messages: It seems like #p102# in #m10000000# still has more weird stuff he wants to collect.
#p102# in #m10000000# asked me for even weirder items to complete his collection. He said he absolutely NEEDS an intact #b#t4000008##k... Why is he even collecting this kind of stuff?
I delivered a #t4000008# to #p102# in #m10000000#. I guess I should keep his weird hobby a secret between us.
quests.name: Teo's Even Weirder Hobby

messages: I hear that #p203# in #m10001000# is worried about something...

I ran into #p203# in #m10001000#, who seemed overcome with worry. She told me that they were short on decorations for the village festival and asked me to get #b10 #t4000007#s#k and #b20 #t4000010#s#k.
I brought back all the stuff #p203# asked me for, but I'm sure these decorations are not the only things needed for the festival...
quests.name: Mrs. Ming Ming's First Worry

messages: I hear #p203# in #m10001000# has a new concern...

I saw #p203# again in #m10001000#; she's still preparing for the village carnival. She said that this time she needs food for the carnival and asked me to collect #b10 #t4000008#s#k, #b30 #t4000012#s#k, and #b#t4031005##k. To get the Special Sauce, I think I'll have to go find #p300# in #m10002010#.
I met up with #b#p300##k in #m10002010# to get her #b#t4031005##k, but she apparently doesn't want to give it to me for free...
quests.name: Mrs. Ming Ming's Second Worry

messages: #b#p300##k in #m10002010# wants a #t4020100##k in exchange for her Special Sauce. She wants to buy a necklace for her mom's birthday gift.
I got #b1 #t4020100##k for #b#p300##k, who I met near #m10002010#, for making her mother's birthday present. She gave me #b#t4031005##k. I better collect the other materials and return to #p203#.
quests.name: Estelle's Request

messages: I got the Special Sauce from #p300# in #m10002010#. Now, I need to deliver it to #p203#, along with #b10 #t4000008#s#k and #b30 #t4000012#s#k.
I got all the materials that #p203# asked me to get and gave them to her. I can't wait to see the village carnival!
quests.name: Estelle's Special Sauce

messages: Under the watchtower in #m10001050#, I saw Pia, who was wearing a teddy bear costume. How cute! She told me that she ran into a bully #o16# on her way to #m10002000#, and now she wants me to show the rude mushroom who's boss! I need to collect #b20 #t4000013#s#k and #b20 #t4000016#s#k to show her as evidence. I contemplated telling Pia she's basically asking to be teased, wandering around the forest in a teddy bear costume like that, but I decided against it.

I delivered #b20 #t4000013#s#k and #b20 #t4000016#s#k to Pia in #m10001050#. She was thrilled that she got vengeance on the mushrooms and gave me a scroll for hat. All I have to do is click on it in the Use tab of my Item Inventory and drag it to my helmet in the Equipment window... Oh, and I'll have to cross my fingers and hope the scroll doesn't fail.
quests.name: Pia and the Blue Mushroom

messages: I hear that #p204# in #m10001000# is worried about something...
I met #p204# in #m10001000#, and, because of her timid disposition, she needs me to deliver #b#t4031008##k to #b#p225##k for her. I can get to #m10001082# through #m10001080#...

I delivered a gift from #p204# to #p225#. I'm sure they're really close friends, since they're giving each other what's most precious to themselves. I wish I could meet a friend like that during my journey...
quests.name: Camila's Gem

messages: I hear that #p207# in #m10001000# is very sick...

A girl named #p207# in #m10001001# has been ill for a long time. It seems like she hasn't been able to live a normal life at all, so I agreed to do what I could to help. #b#t4031009##k... What a strange name! She told me that it helps improve her health, at least a little bit... I should go to #m10000000# and see this guy, #b#p102##k.

#p207# wanted me to go see #p102# of Lith Harbor, so I did just that. He promised to give me the #t4031009#, but only after I get him a #b#t4031011##k. Geez, he won't even give any free medicine for a sick girl?
quests.name: Maya of Henesys

messages: In #m10000000#, I met a heavily bearded crew member named #p102#. He does have the #b#t4031009##k, but explained that, in order for it to work properly, it needs a #b#t4031011##k. He told me that he'll hand the medicine over if I can bring one to him. To get the #b#t4031011##k, I need to head to #m10004002# and speak with #b#p510##k, the daughter of the store's owner.
I met #p510#. To make the #t4031011#, she said she needs #b#t4031010##k.
quests.name: Finding Sophia

messages: I met #p510# in #m10004002#. She told me that she's working on her dream of becoming an alchemist. To make the Sparkling Rock, she says she needs #b30 #t4000006#s#k, #b30 #t4000011#s#k, #b30 #t4000012#s#k, and #b1 #t4031010##k. Everything looks reasonable enough... wait, #t4031010#?! Fortunately, #p510# knew where to get some. She told me to have a chat with #p502#, who should be somewhere around #m10004000#.
#p510# told me that #p502# has some #t4031010#, a key ingredient in making a #t4031011#.
quests.name: Making a Sparkling Rock

messages: I found #p502# in #m10004000#, and as expected, he was unwilling to give me any #b#t4031010##k for free. He told me to go to the underground tunnel in the middle of the island, defeat #r75 #o21#s#k, and gather up #b40 #t4000020##k. I practically shivered from #p502#'s icy demeanor... In that moment, I almost regretted agreeing to help #p207#, but no one else had seemed willing to...
#p502# asked me to defeat #o21#s and gather #t4000020# in return for #t4031010#.
quests.name: Arcon's Blood?

messages: I gathered up #b40 #t4000020##k from the Ant Tunnel and gave them to #p502# of #m10004000#. Still cocky, still arrogant, but following through on his promise, he handed over #b#t4031010##k. Maybe he isn't the WORST. Next, I need to gather up #b30 #t4000006#s#k, #b30 #t4000011#s#k, #b30 #t4000012#s#k, and the #b#t4031010##k for #p510#.
I brought the #b#t4000020##k to #p502# and finally got #b#t4031010##k. I should hurry back to #p510#...
quests.name: Getting Arcon's Blood

messages: #p510# looked genuinely surprised when I handed her all the materials she needed to make the #b#t4031011##k. Well, it wasn't easy! Anyway, she made a #b#t4031011##k with the materials I gathered and gave it to me. The #b#t4031011##k... gives off this strange light and... the way it glitters... I can understand why someone would want one of these! It's mesmerizing! Well, now I just have to trade it with #p102# in #m10000000#.
#p510# was startled when she saw I had gotten #b#t4031010##k, and she made me a #b#t4031011##k with it. Now then, should I go back to #p102# in #m10000000#?
quests.name: Making Sparkling Rock

messages: I gave the #b#t4031011##k to #p102# in #m10000000# and received #b#t4031009##k in return. Now, all I need to do is get this to #b#p207##k, and I'll finally be done. The deeper I get into this, the more I regret saying yes. Anyway, this medicine looks quite tasty. If I ever find myself thirsty and without any water, maybe I should just drink it myself. Hahaha...

I went back to #m10001000# and handed #p207# the Weird Medicine. Hopefully it'll help her get better. As a sign of thanks, #p207# gave me some Mesos and a #b#t1002081##k. The hat... I mean, it looked like it'd protect me from the sun, but it was so old and raggedy... And when I put it on, it made this weird noise... It felt like insects were moving around inside it... Am I going to be okay?
quests.name: Delivering the Weird Medicine

messages: Let's meet #b#p226##k the Security Guy at the #m10001100#.

At the Dungeon Entrance, I met #p226#, the guard. He told me that he wanted to make a nourishing snack for his mother and asked me to hunt #r20 #o18#s#k and #r20 #o17#s#k and bring back #b10 #t4000018#s#k, #b10 #t4000017#s#k, and #b1 #t2020000##k. He said he's too busy with his guard duties to do it himself... but, honestly, he looks like he's sleeping on the job!!

I got #p226#, who protects the entrance of the dungeon, the stuff he asked for. Since he was already making the Snake Drink and all... I wanted a taste for myself! In return, #p226# gave me a nicely refined jewel he found around the area. It's not like refined jewels fall from the sky... Did someone lose it while traveling? Anyway, I should drop by later when the Snake Drink is ready...
quests.name: Luke the Security Guy

messages: I hear that #b#p226##k the Security Guy made up his mind about something...

I met with #p226# at the entrance of the dungeon again. The Snake Drink from back then was completely gone... because he and his mom drank it all... Ah, well. #p226# said he was over the boring life of a security guard and has decided to go on an adventure. To make a glove fit for the journey, #p504# of #m10004000# is asking for #b1 #t4031033##k, #b10 #t4010105#s#k, #b30 #t4000036#s#k, #b20 #t4000050#s#k, and #b20 #t4003000#s#k! He wants me to gather them for him... The fairies of #m10002000# might know something about the #t4031033#.

I brought #p226# the materials he needed to make the gloves and received his treasured heirloom helmet, #b#t1002165##k, in return. It felt like I got the short end of the deal... but since it's a family heirloom, passed down for generations, I couldn't really complain...
quests.name: Luke the Security Guy's Wish to Travel

messages: I got a request from #p207# of #m10001000#, who likes collecting all kinds of items. She wants #b20 of each#k of the following: #b#t4000009##k, #b#t4000013##k, #b#t4000016##k, and #b#t4000019##k. It looks like I can get all of these from hunting monsters around the prairie...
I got everything #p207# asked for, but when do I get rewarded for this? What? How many more times do I have to do this??
quests.name: Maya's First Collection

messages: This time #p207# wants #b20 of each#k of the following: #b#t4000010##k, #b#t4000014##k, #b#t4000026##k, and #b#t4000028##k. I can get those from hunting monsters around the plateau, subway station, and prairie... Well, at least it'll be easy!
I got everything #p207# asked for. Please don't tell me she wanted all of it for free...
quests.name: Maya's Second Collection

messages: #p207# requested #b30 of each#k of the following: #b#t4000023##k, #b#t4000030##k, #b#t4000034##k, and #b#t4000037##k. I can get those from monsters in the highland, beach, and prairie. A little more of a challenge...
I got everything #p207# asked for. I'm still not getting anything?? How many more times do I have to do this??
quests.name: Maya's Third Collection

messages: #p207# asked me to gather #b1 #t4020107##k, #b50 #t4000043##k, and #b50 #t4000044##k. I can get them by defeating monsters at the Golem's Temple, which is on the way from #m10001000# to the dungeon... but this is getting way too hard!

I got all the items #p207# requested for the last time... or is it? As a sign of appreciation, she gave me a cape her grandma made for #p221#, the chief of this town. It may be really old, but it still looks brand new!
quests.name: Maya's Last Collection

messages: Let's go to #p218# in #m10001000#.

I ran into that same teddy-bear-costume-wearing #p218# at the #m10001050#. Last time I saw her, I took care of some #o16#s for her. This time, she wants to make a claw as a present for a friend in #m10002000#, who's embarking on an adventure soon. The claw she wants to make requires #b15 #t4010104#s#k, #b30 #t4000050#s#k, and #b30 #t4003000#s#k... If I get her all these... will I be richly rewarded?
#p218# asked me help her with a gift for her friend who decided to set out on an adventure. I brought back what she needed, but it seemed that wasn't enough.
quests.name: Pia's Present For a Friend

messages: Let's go to #p218# in #m10001000#.
#p218# also asked me to retrieve the #b#t4031064##k that #p201# in #m10001000# borrowed, to give it to her friend too. She'll give me something nice if I bring it back to her.
I went to #p201# to get #p218#'s cape, but #p201# told me that she's keeping the cape until #p218# brings back what she borrowed from her.
quests.name: Looking for the Red Cape

messages: It seems #p201# has her own reasons for not returning #p218#'s cape.

I went to see #p201# in #m10001000#, and she told me she actually took that red cape because #p218# also hasn't returned some items that she borrowed. She says that she'll return the cape when she gets her things back... The items are #b1 #t4020108##k, #b1 #t4001007##k, and #b30 #t4000039##k.
I paid off #p218#'s debt to #p201# on her behalf and received the #t4031064# in return. Next, all I have to do is bring this back to #p218#.
quests.name: What Pia Borrowed

messages: It looks like #p201# is ready to return the #t4031064# she borrowed from #p218#.
I finally got my hands on the #t4031064# that #p218# asked for. Now, I just need to bring it back to her.

I delivered the materials needed to make the claw to #p218# in #m10001050# and received a scroll in return. I wonder if #p218#'s friend has already set out on their adventure by now. Who knows? Maybe I'll run into them during my travels!
quests.name: Pia's Gift

messages: I should go see #p206# in #m10001000#...

I met #p206#, who's been studying the monsters and animals around #m10001000#. His bright smile and easygoing demeanor belie the painful fact that his daughter has been missing for some time now. The reason he's been studying the mushroom monsters is to uncover clues as to his daughter's whereabouts. He asked if I could help him out, and I just couldn't say no to such a worthy cause...
I helped #p206# gather up the materials necessary for his studies. Will these help him find his daughter?
quests.name: The Reason Behind the Mushroom Studies

messages: I wonder how #p206# is doing in #m10001000# these days...

I met up with #p206# in #m10001000#, and he had great news; he finally found his daughter!! There's one problem, however... She is suffering from amnesia! Bruce gave me a toy that his daughter liked to play with growing up and asked me to deliver it to her.
I found #p506# and gave her #t4031076#.�
quests.name: I Need to Find My Daughter 1

messages: It seems that #p506#, having regained her memories of the past, is eager to share the news with her father.

Amazingly, #p506# recovered from her amnesia with the help of her toy sword. It was amazing! The only thing left now is for #p506# and #p206# to finally reunite. But first, I have to get this letter from #p506# back to #p206#.
I was so glad that #p506# got her memory back. I was even gladder that #p206# finally got to see his daughter again! How touching...
quests.name: I Need to Find My Daughter 2

messages: Heard #b#p218##k in #b#m10001000##k got her hands on a strange book. What kind of book could it be? Let’s go see her.

The book is about the #bOldest Snail#k in Maple World and its #b#t2210000##k. It looks like #p218# is interested in the snail’s shell because it makes wishes come true. #p205# is the original owner of the book; he must know something about the author. Let’s go see him.
#p205# said that the author of #b#t4160001##k was his great-grandfather, #bAlloy#k, who was also #b#p203#’s#k grandfather.
quests.name: The Old Snail

messages: #b#p203##k in #b#m10001000##k seems to have something to tell you.

Took #p205#’s advice and visited #p203# to ask about #bAlloy#k, the author of #b#t4160001##k. She said her grandfather’s latest letter was about #bWing, the Fairy of #m10002000##k, and suggested I go see #p309#.
#p309# recalls #bAlloy#k as the human who obtained #r#o700004#’s#k shell to extend his own lifespan. Let’s ask a few more questions.
quests.name: Hero of the Story

messages: Would #p309# in #m10002000# know anything about the Alloy...?
#p309# not only knew about Alloy, but also knew of #o700004#, the snail with the #r#t2210000##k. Wing offered to reveal #o700004#’s location on one condition: bring him some #bsnail shells#k.
Gave snail shells to #p309# and in return got information that #o700004# frequently appeared near the thicket around the beach.
quests.name: Snail Hunt

messages: I learned a lot from #b#p309##k in #b#m10002000##k.
#p309# in #m10002000# told me that #r#o700004##k has been spotted in the thicket around the beach near #m10000000#. Time to head back to #b#p218##k in #b#m10001000##k.
#p218# in #m10001000# seems all fired up.
quests.name: What I Learned About Snails

messages: Looks like #p218# has another favor to ask.

#b#p218##k asked me to go to #b#m010000013##k, take out #r#o0700004##k, and bring back its #b#t2210000##k. So you get to stay here while I do all the work for you again? Don't you think that's a bit much? Maybe I'll just keep the #b#t2210000##k for myself!

The #b#t2210000##k wasn’t an item that makes dreams come true. It turns people who use it into snails. Phew… learned a good lesson not to believe in rumors, otherwise I would be the one crawling about.
quests.name: A rainbow snail shell that makes wishes come true!?
quests.demandSummary: Bring the #t2210000# to #b#p218##k or use the #t2210000#, then talk to #b#p218##k.

messages: #p304# from #m10002000# has lost something...

#p304# from #m10002000# told me that she lost #b#t4001000##k a couple of days ago, on her way to #m10004000#. A monster covered in flames stole it! Fairies tend to obsess over glimmering, shiny objects, so she obviously wants it back... Time to go hunt some boars near #m10004000#.

I returned #t4001000# to #p304# in #m10002000#. I got lucky, finding it off a nasty #o30#. As a sign of gratitude, she gave me a fairy item. It's gorgeous and glimmers like a star. Maybe I can use this to make something special.
quests.name: Arwen and the Glass Shoe

messages: I think #p305# in #m10002000# has something to ask me...

I ran into #b#p305##k again, who had given me #t4031031# for #p320#, #p608#'s son, last time. Back then, she seemed guarded, but now, she's accepted me as #p320#'s friend... \r\n\r\n#p305# is an assistant for the head magician of Ellinia, #p313#. She's concerned about the #t4000033#s: evil dolls he'd made with black magic, a long, long time ago. While they'd been sealed for quite some time, a bunch of #o35#s recently stole them and got away. The #o35#s have since become zombies and are destroying the forest. To take back the forest, someone needs to eliminate the #r#o38#s#k and take the #b#t4000033#s#k away from them... So, I readily accepted the request to collect #b50 Cursed Dolls#k, but I fear those crazy monkeys may be too much to handle...
I eliminated a bunch of #o38#s in a forest near #m10002000# and collected all #b50 #t4000033#s#k for Rowen. In return, she gave me 7 ores. I hope the forest returns to normal...
quests.name: Collecting 50 Cursed Dolls

messages: 70? Well, that shouldn't be too hard...
I eliminated a bunch of #o38#s in the forest near #m10002000# and collected all #b70 #t4000033#s#k for Rowen. In return, she gave me 10 ores. I hope the forest returns to normal soon...
quests.name: Collecting 70 Cursed Dolls

messages: #p305# asked for my help again, this time to hunt #r100 #o38#s#k and collect #b100 #t4000033#s#k. It's getting quite serious now...
I eliminated a bunch of #o38#s in a forest near #m10002000# and collected all #b100 #t4000033#s#k for Rowen. In return, she gave me 5 very rare ores. I hope the forest returns to normal soon...
quests.name: Collecting 100 Cursed Dolls

messages: #p305# asked for my help again, this time to�hunt #r150 #o38#s#k and collect #b150 #t4000033#s#k. Now that's a lot of #t4000033#s!

I eliminated a bunch of #r#o38#s#k in a forest near #m10002000# and collected all #b150 #t4000033#s#k for Rowen. In return, she gave me a scroll for gloves. I hope the forest returns to normal soon...
quests.name: Collecting 150 Cursed Dolls

messages: #p305# asked for my help one last time, this time to hunt #r200 #o38#s#k and collect #b200 #t4000033#s#k. Does she really need THIS many? Is it working?

I eliminated a bunch of #o38#s in a forest near #m10002000# and collected all #b200 #t4000033#s#k for #p305#. In return, she gave me a nice hat. I collected so many dolls for her, but it seemed like the #o38#s aren't decreasing in any way, shape, or form... I wonder what was going on. However, it seemed that the fairies might not have as much animosity toward humans now... That's a good thing, at least.
quests.name: Collecting 200 Cursed Dolls

messages: Let's go meet #p320# in the woods in #m10002071#.

#p320# from the forest of #m10002000# asked me for help gathering materials to build a house for the newborn fairies that are to come down the road soon. I can collect #b30 #t4000019#s#k and #b30 #t4000027#s#k by hunting #r#o19#s and #o31#s#k...
I got all the items #p320# requested, but when do I get rewarded for this? What? How many more times do I have to do this??
quests.name: First Material Delivery for Building a New House

messages: Meet #p320# in the #m10002071#.

#p320# asked me to collect #b30 #t4000014#s and #t4000028#s#k by taking down #r50 #o14#s and 50 #o32#s#k. I should be able to get them from the monsters living in the #m10003000# subway. That sounds like it'll be no problem!
I got everything for #p320#. Please don't tell me he wanted all these for free...!
quests.name: Second Material Delivery for Building a New House

messages: Meet #p320# in the #m10002071#.

#p320# asked me to hunt #r50 #o30#s#k and #r50 #o40#s#k and collect #b30 #t4000026##k and #b30 #t4000036##k. I should be able to get them from the monsters around #m10004000#. Things are starting to get a bit tricky...
I got everything for #p320#. I still didn't get anything?? How many more times do I have to do this??
quests.name: Third Material Delivery for Building a New House

messages: Meet #p320# in the #m10002071#.

#p320# asked me for help one last time. This time, he wants me to get #b30 #t4000034#s#k, #b10 #t4000050#s#k, and #b1 #t4020107##k by taking down #r#o37#s#k and #r#o45#s#k. I guess I can do it, but hunting down in the deep parts of the Ant Tunnel... This is way too hard!!

I got all the materials #p320# needed for the last time. Is this it? For the reward, he gave me a scroll for shoes he got as a gift from the fairies, who found it somewhere around the forest. He couldn't figure out how to use the scroll, so I'm getting it... hopefully it works... haha...
quests.name: Last Material Delivery for Building a New House

messages: Whenever I walk past #p309# in #m10002000#, he seems to be asking for help. I wonder why...

#p309# of #m10002000# seems to have a general disdain for humans. Definitely not the kind of attitude I'd expect from someone asking for a FAVOR. Well, he asked me to get him #b10 #t4000011#s#k, #b10 #t4000006#s#k, and #b3 #t4000007#s#k. They're ingredients for a potion he was assigned to make for homework.
I helped #p309# of #m10002000# with his homework. I have no idea what that potion is for, though.
quests.name: I Need Help on My Homework!

messages: It looks like #p306# in #m10002000# is looking for an adventurer to lend a hand.

#p306# in #m10002000# wants to eat a delicious mushroom dish and asked me to find some ingredients for him. He said that #b#t4000013#s#k are a favorite of his, so I should head out and hunt #r#o13#s#k near the forest.
I gave #t4000013#s to #p306# in #m10002000#. Can he really make a delicious meal out of this?
quests.name: How to Enjoy Mushrooms

messages: It looks like #p306# in #m10002000# has another favor to ask.
#p306# in #m10002000# said he learned of an even better way to cook #t4000013#s and asked me to bring some #b#t4000013#s#k, as well as a #b#t2010005##k.
I delivered the #t4000013#s and #t2010005# to #p306# in #m10002000#. It feels like the dish might actually taste better than the last one, doesn't it?
quests.name: How to Enjoy Mushrooms Even More

messages: Rumor has it there is a hidden room above the #b#m010002003##k... I should keep an eye out for it next time I'm in there.

#b#p326##k asked me to recover #b25 #t4031118##k the #rfairies#k took, then have #b#p202##k in #b#m010001000##k stamp the cover.\nI can probably find fairies in #b#m010002080##k, #b#m010002081##k, or #b#m010001005##k.
#b#p202##k stamped the cover, but he doesn't want me returning to #b#p326##k with a damaged book.
quests.name: The Filing Error

messages:
#b#p202##k asked me to speak to him again about the pages I retrieved for #b#p326##k.
#b#p202##k made out one word in the damaged pages. He sent me to #b#p502##k in #b#m010004000##k.
#b#p502##k recognized the handwriting and remembered part of the entry. He asked me to speak with him again once I was ready.
quests.name: Chief Stan's Signature

messages:
#b#p502##k asked me to speak with him again about the ledger.
#b#p502##k thought #b#p602##k in #b#m010005000##k might be able to repair the pages.
#b#p602##k agreed to work on the ledger. He asked me to come back once he'd made a start.
quests.name: Repairing the Book

messages:
#b#p602##k is working on the ledger. I should see how far he's gotten.
#b#p602##k rebound the ledger but couldn't restore one long entry. He sent me to the #b#p606##k, who keeps records of her own.
The #b#p606##k couldn't decode the long entry at all. She directed me to #b#m010003000##k to speak with the #b#p411##k.
quests.name: The Faded Ink

messages:
The receptionist sent the ledger ahead to #b#m010003000##k for me. The long entry names the #b#p411##k, but parts of it are missing.
#b#p411##k found his own name in the ledger and didn't care for it. He couldn't tell me much, but he sent me to #b#p402##k on the rooftops.
#b#p402##k filled in the part about the bench. Now to make my way to #b#p313##k.
quests.name: The Dark Lord's Signature

messages:
#b#p402##k sent the ledger ahead to #b#p313##k in the #b#m010002003##k. The oldest part of the entry names him.
#b#p313##k read the whole entry and couldn't make sense of it. He told me to take the ledger back up to #b#p326##k and ask her what it means.
#b#p326##k explained what the entry really is, and she has written me into the registry.
quests.name: We Hold Your Place

messages: There is a runaway kid named #p402# in #m10003000#...

On a lonely building rooftop in #m10003000#, I met a boy named #p402#, who's run away from home because of a fight with his father, #p202#, in #m10001000#. But #p402# is exhausted from being on the run and is out of money. He wants to go home and try to work things out with his strict, but admittedly loving, father. He asked me if I could persuade his father to not punish him for what he did. Also, he wants me to bring the #b#t4031006##k his mother left him when she died, as proof that he really did have his father's forgiveness.
As #p402# requested, I looked for his father in #m10001000# to get #p402#'s mother's #b#t4031006##k.
quests.name: Alex's Request

messages: At the entrance of #m10001000#, I met #p402#'s father, #p202#, the chief of Henesys. He wouldn't let me even start a conversation about Alex with him, and he demanded I bring him #b15 #t4000013#s#k and #b15 #t4000016#s#k if I want to talk to him.
Only after I brought the #t4000013#s and #t4000016#s did #p202# start talking to me.
quests.name: Talking to Stan

messages: At the entrance of #m10001000#, I met #p402#'s father #p202#, the chief of #m10001000#. He was even more ornery and difficult to talk to than I'd anticipated, but I finally convinced him to accept #p402# back home with open arms. I also got #p402#'s late mother's #b#t4031006##k as proof. Now, all I need to do is deliver this watch to #p402# in #m10003000#.

I gave #p402# his late mother's #b#t4031006##k. As a sign of appreciation, he gave me an earring he received from friends he met while traveling. Well, #p202# forgave #p402#, but it doesn't seem like #p402# plans to head home right away. Maybe I should keep an eye open next time I'm in #m10001000#.
quests.name: Mother's Gold Watch

messages: I hear that #p406# at #m10003000# is the one to talk to if I'm looking for work...

I paid #p406# a commission of 1,000 mesos in exchange for her bringing me various jobs and requests from the citizens of #m10003000#. The first request is from #p409#, the owner of the armor shop, who needs materials for crafting new armor. I need to defeat #r20 #o9#s#k and #r20 #o10#s#k, and collect #b10 #t4000009#s#k and #b10 #t4000010#s#k. It shouldn't be too hard, since #o9#s and #o10#s are easy to find near #m10003000#.

I delivered what #p409# asked for and got a bunch of #t2010005#s in return. I wonder what kind of armor #p409# will make. Nella said there are many more requests I can fulfill. I should visit #p406# every once in a while.
quests.name: Don Hwang's Request

messages: I got a second request from #p406#. #p403#, who usually hangs out in front of the subway, wants to build a house for the puppy she just got from a friend. I need to defeat #b25 #o11#s#k and bring #b15 #t4000011#s#k to #b#p406##k for the dog house.
I delivered what #p403# asked for and got a bunch of #t2020002#s in return. Now, #p403#'s little puppy has his own house. Return to #p406# for another gig.
quests.name: Shumi's Request

messages: I got a third request from #p406#. #p414#, an assistant at the Kerning City Hair Salon, is a lifelong bachelor and is apparently struggling with improving his cooking skills. He wants to try his hand at making some tasty seafood soup. I'll need to defeat #b30 #o12##k and collect #b20 #t4000012#s#k, and also get #b1 #t2022000##k. Once I've gathered everything, I need to deliver them to #p406#.
I delivered what #p414# asked for and got a glove in return. I hope he enjoys his hearty bowl of Seafood Soup. Return to #p406# for another gig.
quests.name: Andre's Request

messages: #p406# thinks I've grown a lot since my last visit; she's going to start giving me tasks of a slightly higher difficulty from here on out. First, she told me that #p410#, the owner of Kerning City Pharmacy, was working on a new potion when he ran out of ingredients. He needs me to hunt #r40 #o18#s#k and #r40 #o19#s#k, and collect #b20 #t4000018#s#k and #b20 #t4000019#s#k. Taking on #o18#s could be a bit tricky, but for me, it shouldn't be too much trouble!
I delivered what #p410# asked for and got a bunch of #t2000002#s in return. I wonder what kind of potion #p410# will make using those materials. Return to #p406# for another gig.
quests.name: Dr. Faymus's Request

messages: I got another request from #p406#. #p415#'s pillow was stolen a few days ago, and now he just can't get to sleep. To make a new pillow, he needs #b20 #t4003002#s#k and #b20 pieces of #t4000049##k. I should get them as soon as possible, so Chris can get some sleep!
I delivered what #p415# asked for and got some refined iron and bronze in return. #p415# can finally sleep well with his new pillow. Return to #p406# for another gig.
quests.name: Chris's Request

messages: I got another request from #p406#. #p408#, the owner of the weapon shop, is quite the unusual foodie--he wants to cook up a special dish of Evil Eye Tail Stew. He needs me to hunt #b50 #o23#s#k and bring back #b30 #t4000022#s#k. Sounds like he'll be eating well for a while! Once I've gotten everything, I should bring it all back to #b#p406##k.

I delivered what #p408# asked for and got a pair of shoes in return. Now... #p408# doesn't have to worry about his dinner menu for a while. After helping out the people in this town, I feel like I've really become close with them!
quests.name: Cutthroat Manny's Request

messages: I hear someone's been seen inside the #m10003004# in #m10003000#...

I met #b#p412##k inside the #m10003004# in #m10003000#. #b#p412##k needs to take off her bandages to see the results of her surgery, but there's no mirror in the nearly abandoned building. #b#p412##k asked me to defeat #r40 #o17#s#k and collect #b20 #t4031007#s#k, so she could take a look at herself...
I actually collected #t4031007# for the stranger I met in the #m10003004# and brought it back to her.
quests.name: Stranger's Request

messages: The stranger I met in the #m10003004# was, surprisingly, a ghost! She's been in the hospital all this time--unaware that she'd died, waiting for Dr. Niora to return... Now, unwilling to accept her death, she needs me to defeat #b50 #o21#s#k and collect #b25 #t4000020##k to bring her back to life. I really wonder if that's all it takes...

#p412#, whom I met in the #m10003004# was a ghost. She was staying in the Hospital, not knowing that she was dead. She couldn't be revived with the #t4000020#. It seemed, deep down, that she already knew that, though... I really hope she finds peace.
quests.name: Stranger's Identity

messages: It seems that�#b#p800000##k in #b#m10003000##k is looking for a party to take on a party quest that requires multiple adventurers to work together.

#b#p800000##k in #b#m10003000##k asked me to challenge the party quest #bFirst Time Together#k and defeat #b#o800003##k inside. The party quest must be attempted by a party of #bfour adventurers, all level 21 or higher#k. Once all members are ready, the party leader can speak to #p800000# to start the party quest. Better start looking for some friends to join me.
As requested by #b#p800000##k, my friends and I challenged the party quest #bFirst Time Together#k and defeated #o800003#. When everyone works together, there's nothing that can't be done!
quests.name: Proof of Companionship

messages: Let's start looking for #p403# in #m10003000#.

I met this girl named #p403# in #m10003000#. She's devastated about losing the lucky coin that she borrowed from a friend, and she asked me to find it for her. She told me a bunch of guys draped in white cloths picked it up when she dropped it, and that I might find them at #bConstruction Site B1#k, deep in the subway station... I guess I should head there first...

I found the lost coin that #p403# of #m10003000# was looking for and returned it to her. A precious coin borrowed from her friend, huh...? As a reward, she gave me a bunch of return scrolls... Not bad at all!! She also said other items can be found at #bConstruction Site B1#k... I should check it out later...
quests.name: [Construction Site B1] Shumi's Lost Coin

messages: Let's go look for #p403# in #m10003000#.

I ran into #p403# again in #m10003000#. She was really stressed out because she lost her rent money when a #o17# flew over and snatched it from her. Man... Do I have to go back down to the subway again...? Can I just pay her rent for her at this point? Anyway, I need to go back in there, this time to #bConstruction Site B2#k, and find the roll of cash she lost. Aye, better get going...

I got Shumi from #m10003000# the lost roll of cash. Guess she can pay her rent now... and as a reward, she gave me #b30 #t2000003#s#k... She also said I can find other items at #bConstruction Site B2#k... I should go check it out sometime...
quests.name: [Construction Site B2] Shumi's Lost Roll of Cash

messages: Let's go look for #p403# in #m10003000#.

I ran into #p403# again at #m10003000#. A while ago, she was doing a favor for #p401# and getting some #t4003000#s for him. But the Sack of Cash he gave her to buy them fell out of her pocket while she was walking around in the subway, and she lost it. She said it fell deep into the subway station, to #bConstruction Site B3#k.

I found #p403#'s lost Sack of Cash in the #m10003000# subway. #p403# can now buy what #p401# asked for. I received Mesos and some potions as a gift. I should go to #bConstruction Site B3#k in the subway to look for more stuff.
quests.name: [Construction Site B3] Shumi's Lost Sack of Cash

names.en: [Construction Site B3] Shumi's Lost Sack of Cash
names.es: [Sitio de construcción B3] El Saco de dinero perdido de Shumi

messages: I should go see #p407#, who's at the top of a building in #m10003000#. He seems to be bored out of his mind.�
I went to talk to #p407# in #m10003000#. What exactly was he doing, staring aimlessly at the sky? He seemed really bored and asked me if I'd answer his questions.
I answered all the questions that #p407# of #m10003000# asked. That was easy.
quests.name: I'm Bored 1

messages: I answered all the questions that #p407# of #m10003000# asked. That was easy.
I answered all of #p407#'s questions. But he still seemed bored out of his mind; he asked me if I'd bring him a toy to play with.
I had fun playing around with #p407#.
quests.name: I'm Bored 2

messages: Apparently, there's someone in #m10003000# by the name of #p407# that stands on top of a building just staring at the sky, 24/7.

I went to meet #b#p407##k on top of a building in #m10003000#. He was a nice guy with an unquenchable thirst for flying. He's trying to fulfill his lifelong dream of flying by building a hang glider. He asked if I'd gather up the materials for it, and I couldn't reject his sincere desire to fly, even though this whole endeavor seems dubious at best. I'll need to get him #b30 #t4000017#s#k, #b10 #t4003001#s#k, and #b15 #t4003002#s#k.

I got the materials #p407# needed to make the hang glider and realize his dream of flying. I just wonder if Stirge wings are enough to make the hang glider fly... I don't really know if this will work, but who knows, he could end up succeeding. I should check up on him when he's done building it.
quests.name: Icarus's Hang Glider

messages: I wonder how #p407#'s doing with the hang glider... Maybe I should go check up on him in #m10003000#.

#p407# failed to build a working hang glider, and, persistent in his never-ending quest for flight, is now attempting to create a flying balloon. This seems just as preposterous as his last idea, but I don't think I can stop him, so I might as well help him. To make the flying balloon, he needs #b50 #t4000028#s#k and #b10 #t4031078#es#k. For his sake, I really hope this works...

I got the materials needed for #p407# to make a flying balloon and realize his dream of flying. I don't know if his 'flying balloon' will actually fly, but there's a chance that it might work. I'll check up on him around when the flying balloon should be ready to take flight and see if he's for real this time.
quests.name: Icarus and the Balloon

messages: I wonder how #p407#'s doing with the flying balloon... Maybe I should go check up on him in #m10003000#.

Icarus's flying balloon didn't work out, but his quest for flight continues. This time, he wants to deviate from a scientific approach and opt for a magical one. He asked me to go see his best friend, #b#p309##k, in #m10002000#, the town of fairies. Apparently, #p309# knows how to make #b#t4031079##k... I'll need to go see him in #m10002000#, for #p407#'s sake.
#p309# in #m10002000# dislikes humans so much that he wouldn't even listen to what I had to say.
quests.name: In search of Wing the Fairy

names.en: In search of Wing the Fairy
names.es: En busca de Wing el Hada

messages: It doesn't seem easy to talk to #p309#.

I met #p309# in #m10002000#, and he REALLY doesn't seem to like people. As a whole. How did he and Icarus become best friends in the first place? Anyway, in order to make the #b#t4031079##k, he needs #b50 #t4000039##k and #b20 #t4031012#s#k. That's really all it takes to fly?
As #p309# asked, I got him the #t4000039# and #t4031012# items. Can he make the #t4031079# with these?
quests.name: The Ingredients for the Flying Medicine

messages: It looks like the #t4031079# that will finally fulfill #p407#'s dream is finally ready.
#b#p309##k of #m10002000# asked me to deliver the #t4031079# to #p407#. So this little bottle can make someone fly? I need to get this to #p407# ASAP.
I got #p407# the #t4031079# that #p309# of #m10002000# made. I hope it works for him.
quests.name: Delivering the Flying Medicine

messages: I hear that #p501# in #m10004000# is fixing up his house.

In the dusty town of #m10004000#, I ran into a man named #p501#. He needs to fix his house and asked if I could help him out by defeating #r20 #o6#s#k and #r20 #o11#s#k and getting him #b10 #t4000005#es#k and #b10 #t4000011#s#k. If I do him a favor, I'll get a nice shield from him, but what if I say no? I won't be... BANISHED from the village... will I? I really hope not...

I got #p501# of #m10004000# 10 #t4000005#es and 10 #t4000011#s after defeating 20 #o6#s and 20 #o11#s. With these, he can finally fix his house. I got this shield as a reward... and... well, there are scratch marks here and there, and it looks pretty old... Is this even usable?
quests.name: Fixing Blackbull's House

messages: I hear that #p501# in #m10004000# is building a new house...

I ran into #p501# again, the guy whose house I'd helped fix before. He was surprised at how strong I'd gotten and asked me for another favor, a bit harder than the last one. His cousins from #m10001000# are trying to move to #m10004000#, so he needs to build a new house for them! The materials he needs for this project are #b100 #t4000043#s#k, #b30 #t4003000#s#k, #b30 #t4003001##k, and #b#t4001006##k. His son had the deed when it was stolen by #o31#s near #m10005000#... Hmmm... I should look for ones wandering around in the Deep Forest...
I got #p501# the items he requested, so that all of his cousins could move to #m10004000#. It was really tough, and I hope he doesn't ask me to BUILD a house for him next time...
quests.name: Building a New House For Blackbull

messages: I visited #b#p502##k again, whom I'd first met in #m10004000#, when making the medicine for #p207# of #m10001000#. Surprised at how much stronger I've become, #p502# asked me for a favor. Long ago, when he was in danger of being struck down by Balrog, he was saved by the legendary hero Tristan, who ended up dying in Manji's place. Ever since then, Manji has held onto Tristan's sword. However, the blade was so corrupted by Balrog that it's almost too worn down to even be called a sword anymore...\n#p502# handed me the #b#t1302009##k that he'd held onto all these years and asked me to reawaken its true form. Once fully awakened, it will become the #b#t1302014##k. #p502# told me to begin with seeking out #b#p602##k in #b#m10005000##k.
I met #b#p602##k in #b#m10005000##k and was able to ask him how to awaken the #b#t1302009##k.
quests.name: Old Gladius

messages: See #b#p602##k in #m10005000#�to awaken the�#b#t1302009##k.

I showed #p602# #p502#'s #b#t1302009##k, and he revealed that he was the sword's creator. He needs #b1 #t4020109##k, #b1 #t4003004##k, #b1 #t4001007##k, and #b1 #t4001008##k to awaken it. Unfortunately, I've never heard of any of those items... He recommended talking to #b#p513# in #m10004121##k to get started.

I gathered the materials needed for the awakening and took them to #p602#. #p602# used the materials to reawaken the #t1302009# into the #b#t1302014##k. It's a nice sword that radiates a mysterious light... It's a shame I have to give it to #p502#.
quests.name: Reawakening the Gladius

messages: After much hardship, I finally managed to gather all the materials #p602# asked for. Now, I can only trust in his power.
With #p602#'s help, I awakened the #t1302009#, entrusted to me by #p502#, into the #t1302014#. All that remains now is to return the sword to #p502#.

It seems that this #t1302014#, which #p502# told me about, is one fine sword. I had to make a hard decision choosing between the #b#t1302014##k and the #b#t1032013##k that #p502# offered me, but I don't regret my choice.
quests.name: Hero's Gladius

messages: I hear that #p512# the archeologist is searching for something in the Rocky Mountains on the east side of Perion...

#b#p512##k, an archaeologist I ran into in the Rocky Mountains east of Perion, has lost the fossils he's meticulously been collecting in the region. He asked me to bring back #b12 #t4031068#s#k and #b12 #t4031069#s#k, which have been stolen by #r#o13#s#k and #r#o15#s#k. How could he lose such important things? He's more careless than he looks...
I found the fossils that #b#p512##k lost.
quests.name: Searching for Fossils

messages: It seems the archaeologist #p512# in the Rocky Mountains, east of Perion, has another request.

#b#p512# the archaeologist#k has realized that it's not the best idea to leave such valuable fossils in a tent. He asked me to deliver them to #bDr. #p308##k in #m10002000# for safekeeping. He also wrote me a letter of introduction to show her.

#b#p512# the archeologist#k in Perion said that it is not safe to leave the valuable fossils in his tent. He asked me to deliver them to #bDr. #p308##k in #m10002000#. Dr. #p308# said she's going to be really busy from now, and she asked me to stop by again and give her a hand afterwards. Fossils, huh...? Should I give it a try?
quests.name: Delivering a Box of Fossils

messages: Dr. #p308#, a biologist near #m10002000#, is looking for an assistant.
#bDr. #p308##k asked me to help out as her assistant for a bit. My first task is to collect #b8 #t4031072#s#k. I can see a lot of plants covering the woods in #m10002000#.
My first job as Dr. #p308#'s assistant was to collect some plants in the woods in #m10002000# and sample them. It wasn't that hard, I guess.
quests.name: Research on Plant Fossils

messages: It seems the biologist, Dr. #p308#, in #m10002000# has another request.
Dr. #p308# in #m10002000# needs #b1 #t4031073##k for her research. She asked me to fetch one from her daughter, who should be near #m10001000#. But where exactly would #p224# be...?
I met Dr. #p308#'s daughter, #p224#, playing by herself near #m10001000#.
quests.name: Research on Animal Fossils

messages: It looks like #p224# has the item that Dr. #p308# needs.
I got the #t4031073# from #p224#, Dr. #p308#'s daughter. Now, to deliver this VERY CAREFULLY to Dr. #p308#...

I collected some #t4031072#s and a #t4031073# to help Dr. #p308#'s research on fossils. I can't wait to see the results... I should go and see Dr. #p308#, because she said she would tell me when I go back.
quests.name: Transporting Drake's Skull

messages: I hear Dr. #p308# has finished her fossil research. Maybe I should go and see the results.

I visited Dr. #p308# again. She finally completed her research and asked if I could take the final report to Dr. #p512# in #m10004000#. Dr. Betty also informed me that if I were to take #b20 #t4000011#s#k, #b15 pieces of #t4000015##k, #b1 #t4031075##k, and #b1 pair of #t1032002##k, it'd make Dr. #p512# very happy.

I delivered Dr. #p308#'s #t4031074# to Dr. #p512# in #m10004000#. Along with the report, I also gave him the #t4000011#, #t4000015#, #t4031075#, and #t1032002#. In return, Dr. Winston gave me the #t1032015#.
quests.name: Progress on Fossil Research

messages: #p506# of #m10004000# says she can't take one step out of town. I wonder why...

I met #p506# in #m10004000#. She can't remember anything about her childhood and lives every day in fear of the #o6#s that surround Perion. She finds even looking at them too scary. Due to this paralyzing fear of #o6#s, Ayan can't take a single step out of #m10004000#, so she asked me to help her by thinning their numbers. Are they really THAT scary?
I took out #o6#s for #p506#'s sake in #m10004000#. She can finally venture outside without having to worry about them!
quests.name: The Stump Horror Story

messages: I hear something happened to the tribespeople of #m10004000#. I should go ask #p506# about this.

I spoke with #p506# in #m10004000#. A few days ago, a group of tribespeople went hunting in the swamp and wound up being ambushed by a group of Ligators. She's worried about the sudden surge of Ligators, and other alligator monsters, taking over the swamp and asked me to reduce their numbers before they spawn out of control. I'll have to kill #r100 #o29#s#k and #r40 #o18#s#k and pick up #b20 #t4000018#s#k along the way.

The tribespeople of #m10004000# got ambushed by the alligator herd at the swamp, so #p506# asked if I could help take care of the alligators. I responded by taking out 100 #o29#s and 40 #o18#s. Hopefully this will bring some peace back to the swamp.
quests.name: Taking Out the Alligators 1

messages: #p506# of #m10004000# is desperately looking for me. Is something wrong?

I went to see #p506#, and she was in a panic. She had been walking around the swamp one day, when she ran into an even bigger, stronger, and more dangerous group of alligators, Crocos. She immediately turned and ran back to #m10004000#. She'd been waiting for me to come by since then, hoping I could help her. This time, I'll need to kill #r120 #o46#s#k and bring back #b50 #t4000041#s#k.
At #p506#'s request, I took out 120 #o46#s in the swamp. I'll have to revisit that spot from time to time and take out the alligators so they don't spawn out of control.
quests.name: Taking Out the Alligators 2

messages: The archeologist, Doctor #p512#, currently does research at a camping site in #m10004051#. He recently called me about a strange rumor he heard.

During the excavation, Doctor #p512# said he heard a rumor about a very old tree living in #m10004000#. However, he had no clue on what kind of tree it was, or where exactly it was located. That's why he's asked me to visit #b#m10004000##k village to collect information on this particular tree. Shall I start by visiting #b#p501##k?
I met #p501# in #m10004000#. Would he know anything about that tree?
quests.name: Truth of the Rumor

messages: Let's ask #b#p501##k in #m10004000# if there's anyone who might know more.
#b#p506##k lived in #b#m10004000##k for a long time. Let's go ask about the rumor.
Asked #p506# about the rumor.
quests.name: Truth of the Rumor-Blackbull

messages: Let's ask #b#p506##k in #m10004000# if there's anyone who might know more.
#b#p502##k has been training at #m10004000# for a long time. Let's go and ask about the rumor.
Asked #p502# about the rumor.
quests.name: Truth of the Rumor-Manji

messages: Let's ask #b#p502##k in #m10004000# if there's anyone who might know more.
Let's ask elder #b#p511##k in #m10004000# about the rumor.
Asked #p511# about the rumor.
quests.name: Truth of the Rumor- Dances with Balrog

messages: Let's ask #b#p511##k in #m10004000# if there's anyone who might know more.
Let's ask botanist #b#p308##k in #m10002000# about the rumor.
Asked Doctor #p308# about the rumor.
quests.name: Truth of the Rumor-Betty

messages: Botanist #b#p308##k in #m10002000# seems to have a suggestion.
Botanist #b#p308##k in #m10002000# suggested that I take all the information I've gathered so far to Archaeologist #p512# in #m10004051#.
Told Doctor #p512# what the villagers of #m10004000# talked about. Could #o700007# mentioned by #p511# be the same tree Doctor #p308# is looking for?
quests.name: A Report for the Doctor

messages: Doctor #p512# seems to have another request.
Doctor #p512# thought the reason why all the stumps in #m10004000# were dry was due to \n#b#o700007##k. To prove his theory, he wanted to do research on the #o6#s' #b#t4031137##k.
Gave Doctor #p512# the collected #t4031137#. Wonder when the research results of #p512# will surface?
quests.name: Stump Research

messages: Doctor #p512# seems to have one last request.

Visited Doctor #p512# again. He says #o700007# seems to take all the nutrients from #m10004000#. He also added that if this continues, #m10004000# would become a wasteland devoid of life. The #r#o700007##k must be eliminated.
Acting on Doctor #p512#'s request, I've tracked down and eliminated #o700007# that was nourishing on #m10004000#. Will this help #m10004000# return to its original state?
quests.name: Monstrous Tree Stumpy

messages: I hear #b#p608##k in #m10005000# is going through hard times... I should go check on him.

I met an old, balding man named #b#p608##k in the VIP Sauna in #m10005000#. His son's run away from home with a book that's apparently more important to him than his own son?? He asked that I find his son, get the book, and bring JUST the book back. He offered me a nice sauna robe as a reward. \r\n#b#p608##k told me that his son, #b#p320##k, likes to hang out at a tree tunnel somewhere around #m10002000#. That's probably a good place to start searching. Seriously, though, just what is in this book of his...???
I found #b#p320##k in the tree tunnel of #m10002000#, as requested by #p608#, whom I met at the #m10005003#.
quests.name: A Clue to the Secret Book

messages: I found #p608#'s son, #b#p320##k, inside a tree tunnel near #m10002000#. He declared that he'd never hand over the red book, but he was also pretty hungry. Ronnie asked me to defeat #r#o35#s#k in the western area of #m10002000# and bring back #b30 #t4000031#s#k.
I brought a bunch of #t4000031#s for the hungry #p320#. But it looked like he still wanted to eat more...
quests.name: Hungry Ronnie

messages: #p320# said that the #t4000031#s weren't enough for him and asked me to go see #p201# at #m10001000# to get a plate of #t4031030#.
I went to see #p201# of #m10001000# to help feed the hungry #p320#.
quests.name: Still Hungry Ronnie

messages: #p201# of #m10001000# needs #b50 #t4000027#s#k and #b10 #t4000008#s#k as ingredients to make her unagi special.
I brought #p201# everything needed to make #t4031030#.
quests.name: Secret to Unagi Special

messages: I brought everything #p201# asked for, and she whipped up a plate of #t4031030# for me. I hope #p320# will finally be satisfied with this...
I brought #t4031030# to #p320#. That kid sure seemed to enjoy it!
quests.name: Rina's Unagi Special

messages: #p320# got thirsty from eating #t4031030#. I need to go see #b#p305##k of #m10002000# to get #ba glass of #t4031031##k for him.
I went to see #p305# of #m10002000# to help quench #p320#'s thirst.
quests.name: Thirsty Ronnie

messages: #p305# of #m10002000# asked for a beautiful, glittering #b#t4020107##k in exchange for #ba glass of #t4031031##k. A #b#t4020107##k... And just how exactly am I supposed to get such a rare, expensive item?
I brought a #t4020107# to #p305#.
quests.name: Cold Milk

messages: I brought #p305# a #b#t4020107##k in exchange for #ba glass of #t4031031##k. I hope #p320# will FINALLY be satisfied with this...
I brought the #t4031031# to #p320#. Phew, I guess he's too full to eat any more now!
quests.name: Satisfied Ronnie

messages: I got #p320# all kinds of yummy snacks and finally got his dad's #t4031032# in exchange. I really want to take just one peek...

I got #p608# the precious #t4031032# that he'd been desperately looking for. I asked him if he's worried about #p320# at all, only to hear that he'll be in good hands with the fairies... Well, it'd be best for #p320# to stay with the fairies, right? Anyway, I got the sauna clothes in return for the book... I guess wearing this cumbersome armor in the sauna is a ridiculous thing to do. Might as well enjoy it now and relax at the sauna...
quests.name: Returned Secret Book

messages: Let's go look for #p603# in #m10005000#.

I met #b#p603##k, a medicinal herb trader, in front of the #m10005001#. He appears to be the younger brother of #p602#. He recently discovered a place that grows the last herb he needs for a medicine he's been working on... He asked me to go deep in the forest and grab the #b#t4031025##k. It's made of green grass and a small pink flower... I need to make sure I get him the same exact one. #b#p306##k from #m10002000# can take me to the right place.

Thankfully, I got the flower that #p603# wanted from the Forest of Patience, and, as a sign of appreciation, he gave me a #bscroll for overall armor#k. Oh, and he also said that from here on out, I can enter the Forest of Patience without having to pay #p306# of #m10002000#. From what I've heard, the diet medicine #p603#'s working on is for #p306#'s fiance... I should go back to the Forest of Patience when I have some spare time...
quests.name: [Forest of Patience] Sabitrama and the Diet Medicine

messages: I hear that #p603# in #m10005000# is making a new medicine...

I ran into #b#p603##k in front of the #m10005001# again, the one I helped get herbs for before. This time, he found a new place with a different important herb that he needs for another type of medicine he's working on. He asked me to go back to the forest and grab a #b#t4031026##k for him. It has a reddish root split in two... I should make sure I grab the same exact one once I get to the top. I guess that means I have to go back to #b#p306##k in #m10002000#...

Thankfully, I got the herb that #p603# asked me to get, and for that, I was rewarded with a mysterious rock. And from here on out, I don't have to pay #p306# every time I go in the Forest of Patience. From what I hear, that anti-aging medicine #p603# is working on may be what #p306# needed... If I have time, I should go back in there...
quests.name: [Forest of Patience] Sabitrama's Anti-Aging Medicine

messages: The rot swallowed #b#p0000707##k's forging fire. Realizing the sickness is a living malice, he wants me to take the scorched scroll to the alchemist #b#p711##k.
I need to deliver the #b#t4031115##k to #b#p711##k in #b#m010006140##k to see if he can explain the living malice.
I delivered the scroll to #b#p711##k. He was fascinated by the volatile anomaly and agreed to investigate.
quests.name: Matters of the Heart

messages: I need to let #b#p711##k analyze the scorched scroll to see if his alchemy can explain why Nyroth's machinery failed against the living malice.
#b#p711##k discovered the soil is skewed by rusted iron from Tristan's ancient battle with the Balrog. I must defeat 50 #b#o58#s#k to clear the toxic air.
I purged the #b#o58#s#k from the area honoring Tristan's memory and clearing the toxicity. But the living malice, #bCaligo#k, lies deeper.
quests.name: A Memory of Iron

messages: I must find #b#p712##k in #b#m010006160##k and tell him that the iron corruption has been purged, making the tree bark pure enough for a magical seal.

#b#p712##k, a friendly mediator for the fairies, explained that the living malice Caligo has consumed the Arcon. To hide the fairies' home from Caligo's gaze, he needs to cast an invisible Stasis Seal. I must gather #b30 #t4000033#s#k and #b20 #t4000057#s#k from the deeper chambers.

I delivered the catalysts to #b#p712##k, who successfully wove the invisible Stasis Seal. The corrupted beasts still roam, but the World Tree's roots have stopped decaying and the fairies are hidden from Caligo's sight. The true battle lies ahead, but we have bought them time.
quests.name: A Heart of Stillness and Wood

messages: The Stasis Seal is only a temporary measure. #b#p712##k asked me to speak with him about warning the fairies on the surface.
I must travel back up to the #b#m010002003##k and deliver the truth to #b#p313##k before the Sages are caught completely off guard.

I returned to #b#m010002000##k and warned #b#p313##k. He was relieved to hear the Cave Fairies survived, but realized the Sages must prepare for the corrupted Arcon. He thanked me for buying them time.
quests.name: The Sage's Burden
quests.demandSummary: Return to #b#p313##k, and inform him of what you've learned.

messages: A cave fairy named #b#p715##k keeps a campfire burning in #b#m010006022##k. She looks like she could use a hand.
#b#p715##k says #r#o60#s#k keep crawling up from #b#m010006100##k toward her campfire. Defeat #r60 #o60#s#k so the camp stays safe.
I cleared out the #o60#s, and #b#p715##k's fire burns quietly again. She seemed to want to talk about something else, too...
quests.name: Embers in the Garden

messages: #b#p715##k has something she wants to share.
#b#p715##k can't read her grandmother's journal. It's written in the old fairy script. Take the #b#t4031140##k to #b#p712##k in #b#m010006160##k.
I brought the #b#t4031140##k to #b#p712##k. He recognized the old script right away.
quests.name: Words Nobody Taught

messages: #b#p712##k has finished reading #bElda#k's journal.

For the Lantern Rite, the hearthkeepers built lantern frames from boughs the #o61#s gave freely. Collect #b30 #t4000058#s#k from #r#o61#s#k and bring them to #b#p711##k in #b#m010006140##k. He knows the way to the old tomb.
I brought the #t4000058#s to #b#p711##k. He will build the lantern frames and guide the way to #b#m010006161##k once I am strong enough.
quests.name: Boughs for the Lanterns

messages: #b#p711##k has finished the lantern frames and is ready to head for the old tomb.
The #r#o62#s#k have scattered the old name-charms all over the deep tunnels. Collect #b30 #t4000059#s#k from them in #b#m010006160##k and #b#m010006161##k, and bring them to #b#p711##k.
I brought the #t4000059#s to #b#p711##k. While cleaning them, he found one with the same mark as the cover of #bElda#k's journal.
quests.name: Charms Gone Gray

messages: #b#p711##k found a charm marked with #bElda#k's sign.
#b#p711##k wants to return the other charms to #b#m010006161##k. Defeat #r60 #o63#s#k there so he can work safely, then take the #b#t4031141##k to #b#p712##k in #b#m010006160##k so he can read it.
I cleared the #o63#s, and #b#p711##k put the charms back on the tomb walls. I gave the #b#t4031141##k to #b#p712##k.
quests.name: The Dilapidated Tomb

messages: #b#p712##k has read #bElda#k's message.
Bring #b#t4031142##k back to #b#p715##k in #b#m010006022##k.
#b#p715##k heard her grandmother's last words. She lit a lantern at her campfire and held the Lantern Rite. She keeps the fire now, as a hearthkeeper.
quests.name: The Last Lantern

messages: A beautiful girl by the name of #p802# from #m10007000# seems to be in need of help...
#p802# introduced me to a part time job, where I have to collect #b10 #t4000061#s#k. Why don't I start collecting those delicious looking #t4000061#s over there on the right?
I brought back fresh #t4000061#s just like #p802# said. Riel told me I can come back for work anytime I want. I guess I won't be starving here in #m10007000#.
quests.name: Special Taste of Florina Beach I

messages: #p802# in #m10007000# asks me a question about #m10007000#. Piece of cake. I can answer that before I start my work.
I have to prepare enough ingredients for 15 people and bring them to #p802# in #m10007000#.
I answered all the questions that #p802# gave me and passed her tests, then went to collect ingredients for 15 people.
quests.name: Special Taste of Florina Beach II

messages: It seems that #p802# in #m10007000# wants to ask for another favor.
I have to bring enough ingredients for 30 people to #p802# in #m10007000#.
I worked a part-time gig gathering ingredients for meals for the tourists coming to #m10007000#.
quests.name: Special Taste of Florina Beach III

messages: #p802# is trying to develop a special dish in #m10007000#.

I need to collect ingredients that will help further cultivate the special taste of #m10007000#: #b10 #t4000061#s#k, #b10 #t4000032#s#k, #b10 #t4000040#s#k, and #b10 #t4000031#s#k. Will #p800#'s new recipe succeed?
