When I met #p218# at #m10001050#, it turned out she was just a girl who wasn't very good at being honest about her feelings. Too embarrassed, or something like that. Still, somehow I think I understand how she feels. #p218# asked me to go tell #b#p204##k that the two of them should visit #p225#'s farm together sometime. Those two are pretty cute, aren't they?�\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.#k
I passed along #p218#'s suggestion to #p204# at #m10001000#. I'm already curious to see what's in store for the three of them — #p204#, #p218#, and #p225#.
quests.name: A Promise Between Three Friends

messages: #p207#, who lives in the little mushroom house in #m10001000#, seems to have something on her mind.

#p207#, who lives in the little mushroom house in #m10001000#, said that a while back, she wandered a bit further from town than usual to pick some delicious mushrooms, and stumbled upon a giant mushroom monster that put her in grave danger — until a warrior appeared out of nowhere and saved her. She wants to track him down and repay his kindness, but he vanished the moment he'd saved her, and she's had no way of finding him since. She's hoping I can help her find some clue. To find any leads, I should probably start by heading to the place where it all happened. It seems I need to look for the #bGiant Mushroom#k somewhere at #b#m10001005##k in Henesys. I suppose I'll have to take it down? \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.#k
I defeated the Giant Mushroom, #b#o700000##k, that I encountered at #m10001005#, and found #b#t4031122##k, which I brought back to #p207#. Could this be a clue that leads me to that person?
quests.name: An Unknown Savior

messages: #p207#, who lives in the little mushroom house in #m10001000#, seems to want to follow the clue written on #t4031122#.

From #b#t4031122##k, which I obtained after defeating #o700000#, the one who'd attacked #p207#, I picked up two leads: #b#m10002000##k and #p602#. I think it'd be best to head to #b#m10005000##k first and go hear what #b#p602##k has to say.  \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.#k
I met #p602# at #m10005000#. It seems I might be able to track down the warrior who saved #p207# more easily than I thought.
quests.name: A Name on a Note

messages: #p602#, who I met at #m10005000#, seems to be hiding something.

#p602#, who I met at #m10005000#, wouldn't say a word, insisting that person wouldn't want to be known — but worn down by my persistent pleading, he reluctantly set one condition. That condition was for me to bring him #t4000036# for his research. It seems I should be able to get #b#t4000036#s#k by defeating #b#o40#s#k, found far off from #m10004000#, or #b#o45#s#k deep within the Ant Tunnel.  \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.#k
I handed over the #t4000036#s to #p602#, who I met at #m10005000#. Now it's time to hear his story about the warrior who saved #p207#.
quests.name: A Price to Pay

messages: It seems #p602#, who I met at #m10005000#, is finally about to reveal the secret.�

#p602#, who I met at #m10005000#, told me to go find #ba man#k standing at the top of #b#m10004000##k. He clearly seems to know more than he's letting on, but for now he seems to be holding his tongue. Let's go find that #bwarrior#k at #b#m10004000##k.� \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.#k
I met #p502# at #m10004000#. I don't think I've ever seen him look so flustered before.
quests.name: A Man Atoning
quests.demandSummary: Talk to the warrior at the top of #m10004000#

messages: The warrior #p207# had been searching for turned out to be #p502# of #m10004000#.�

When I told #p502# of #m10004000# that #b#p207##k was looking for the one who'd saved her life, he seemed to waver for a moment — but then asked me to keep his secret, saying he didn't want her to know who he was. I wonder what I should tell #b#p207##k when I go back to her...  \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.#k
I returned to #p207# at #m10001000# and told her what I'd learned about the one who'd saved her life. She seemed a little disappointed, but somehow looked happy all the same.
quests.name: A Name Never Given

messages: I've finally been recognized as a #bCitizen of Honor#k of #m10001000#.�
It seems #b#p221##k, who leads the town, is looking for me, so I should probably head over right away.� \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.#k
#p221# of #m10001000# personally congratulated me on becoming a #bCitizen of Honor#k.
quests.name: Becoming a Citizen of Honor

messages: It seems #p221# of #m10001000# has something to tell me now that I've become a #bCitizen of Honor#k.

#p221# of #m10001000# said there was a gift prepared for me for becoming a #bCitizen of Honor#k, but that she'd give it to me if I could do her one favor first. She told me that a long, long time ago, she'd hidden a small box containing a bow somewhere in #bthe Golem's Temple#k, but when she recently went to retrieve it, it was gone — and she asked me to go find that box for her. I wonder if #b#o48##k or #b#o49##k out there might have it.  \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.#k
Why would #p221# have hidden this box in a place like that, I wonder?
quests.name: A Box Hidden Long Ago

messages: It seems #p221# of #m10001000# has yet another favor to ask.�

Inside #p221#'s box was a small, old bow. But it had fallen apart after all that time, and #p221# said #b#p208##k should be able to fix it. It seems I should head to #b#p208##k at #b#m10001040##k and show them the bow. Still, if this bow is centuries old, just how many long years has #p221# been alive for?� \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.#k
I showed #t4031124# to #p208#. I hope he's able to fix it...
quests.name: A Worn-Out Bow

messages: #p208# said the #t4031124# is made from a rare wood hardly ever found on Victoria Island, and asked me to gather #t4000050# and #t4000063# as materials to repair the bow. It seems #b#t4000050##k can be obtained from #b#o40##k, #b#o45##k, and #b#o50##k, while #b#t4000063##k can be obtained from monsters imbued with magical energy, such as #b#o47##k, #b#o48##k, and #b#o49##k.� \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.#k
I brought #p208# all the materials needed to repair the bow.
quests.name: A Craftsman's Touch

messages: It seems #p208# is about to show off his skill.�

#b#p208##k of #m10001040#, true to his reputation as the town's finest craftsman, repaired  #b#p221##k's bow to perfection. All that's left now is to bring this #b#t4031125##k back to #b#p221##k.� \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.#k

I brought #t4031125# to #p221# and got to hear her story. That bow once belonged to a friend of hers from back when even #p221# herself was still young and inexperienced — he'd passed away in a war fought centuries ago, and #p221# had kept his bow all this time to remember him by. #p221# thanked me for helping her recover a bow that held such precious memories, and gave me a small gift in return. I should treasure this #b#t1032021##k she gave me too.
quests.name: A Memory Restored

messages: #p229# of #m10001007# seems to have a new offer for me.
#p229# of #m10001007# said he had some good news, and told me that I'd been granted the right to own a house in this town. To hear more details, I should go find #b#p230##k.
#p230# of #m10001007# told me all about houses.
quests.name: The Right to Own a Home

messages: It seems #p230# of #m10001007# has something more to tell me about houses.

It seems I can buy a house from #p231# of #m10001000#. I'll have to remember that.
quests.name: Looking for a House

messages: #p229#, the Town Clerk of #m10001000#, seems to have another proposal.

It seems like #p417#, who works at the subway entrance in #m10003000#, needs #p404#'s help to cure his fear of #o17#. I should ask #b#p404##k in #b#m10003000##k if there is a good way. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.#k�
I went to see #p404# to help cure the fear of #o17# that #p417#, who works at the subway entrance in #m10003000#, is suffering from.
quests.name: Stirge Phobia

messages: #p404# in #m10003000# might know about a cure for a phobia of #o17#.�

I have my doubts about whether #p404# in #m10003000# truly knows anything about #o17#, but as he says, I should look for the materials needed to craft the medicine. I need to defeat #o14# and #o17# around #m10003000# and collect 10 #t4000014#s and 10 #t4000017#s.\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.#k�
I delivered the materials required to craft the medicine for the #o17# phobia to #p404# in #m10003000#.
quests.name: Making the Medicine

messages: It seems like #p404# in #m10003000# still needs something else.

Claiming that he needs the final ingredient for the #o17# phobia cure, #p404# in #m10003000# asked me to go get a #t4031113# from his grandfather, #b#p111##k in #b#m10000000##k. To think that #p111# was #p404#'s grandfather... \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.#k�
#p111# in #m10000000# handed over the #t4031113# with a suspicious look. Will this really be, okay?
quests.name: The Final Ingredient for the Cure

messages: It seems like #p111# in #m10000000# is willing to grant his grandson's request.

I obtained the final ingredient for the #o17# phobia cure, the #t4031113#, from #p111# in #m10000000#. Now, all I need to do is bring this to #b#p404##k in #b#m10003000##k. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.#k�
I delivered all the ingredients for the #o17# phobia cure to #p404# in #m10003000#. Now, I can only hope that he crafts the cure properly.
quests.name: Grandfather's Vitamin Gummy

messages: It seems like #p404# in #m10003000# has finally crafted the #o17# phobia cure.�

I need to deliver the #b#t4031114##k crafted by #p404# to #b#p417##k at the subway entrance in #b#m10003000##k. I hope this helps... \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.#k�

I delivered the #t4031114# crafted by #p404# to #p417# at the subway entrance in #m10003000#. Truth be told, it seems like a medicine with little to no actual effect, but if it gave #p417# the courage he needed, perhaps that is enough.
quests.name: It's All in the Mind

messages: It seems #p402# of #m10003000# has something to tell me.

#p402# of #m10003000# said that even though he'd made up with his father, he'd already gotten used to his free life in #m10003000#, so he was hesitant about going back home. In the meantime, he wanted to repay the people who'd helped him back when he first arrived in #m10003000# and had such a rough time of it, so he'd prepared some gifts for them — but he'd gone and lost them in the marshland, and asked me to help him get them back. Let's defeat #b#o29##k in the marshland near #m10003000# and find #b#t4031126##k. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.#k
I found #t4031126# in the marshland and brought it back to #p402#.
quests.name: A Lost Thank-You

messages: It seems #p402# of #m10003000# has yet another favor to ask.

#p402# of #m10003000# asked me to deliver his gift to #b#p406##k for him. Apparently, he's too embarrassed to hand it over himself. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.#k
I handed #t4031127# over to #p406#.
quests.name: Too Shy to Say It Himself

messages: Did #p406# of #m10003000# like #p402#'s gift?�
#p406# of #m10003000# seemed touched by #p402#'s gift. I should go let #p402# know. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.#k
#p402# seemed pleased to hear that #p406# was happy with the gift. But it looks like he's still got another favor to ask, doesn't he?
quests.name: Nella's Old Memory

messages: It seems #p402# of #m10003000# has one last favor to ask.�
#p402# of #m10003000# asked me to deliver his gift to #b#p401##k. Apparently he's too embarrassed to hand it over himself. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.#k
I handed #t4031128# over to #p401#.
quests.name: One More Debt to Repay

messages: Did #p401# of #m10003000# like #p402#'s gift?�

#p401# of #m10003000# accepted #p402#'s gift with an air of indifference, but seemed secretly pleased deep down. I should go let #p402# know. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.#k
#p402# seemed happy to hear that #p401# had secretly liked the gift. It seems #p402# has learned a lot during his time here in #m10003000#.
quests.name: Not Ready to Go Home Yet

messages: It seems #p412# of #m10003004# has a new favor to ask.

#p412# knew full well she wasn't among the living anymore, and yet she refused to accept it. Worried that Dr. Niora might never come back, she said she'd have to change her own bandages, and asked me to defeat #r#o32##k and gather #b#t4000028##k for her. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.#k
I gathered #t4000028#s for #p412#. I only wish she hadn't asked me to help her change those bandages..
quests.name: Worn Bandages

messages: It seems #p412# of #m10003004# has yet another favor to ask.�

#p412# of #m10003004# said she simply couldn't bring herself to change her own bandages, and asked me to go find Dr. Niora. She said she'd found part of a letter #p425# had sent to Dr. Niora, and thought #p425# might know something about her whereabouts. I should go see #b#p425##k at #b#m10003007##k. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.#k
I met #p425# at #m10003007#. She clearly seems to know something.
quests.name: A Torn Letter

messages: It seems #p425# of #m10003007# knows something about a doctor named Niora.�

#p425# of #m10003007# told me what she knew. According to her, Niora was once a fairly well-known doctor here in #m10003000#, but one day, after an accident at his hospital took the life of a young girl, he vanished from the city. She said she didn't know where Niora had gone, but suggested I go see #b#p406##k if I wanted to learn more.\n#rOnly characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.#k
I went to meet #p406# to try and track down Dr. Niora's whereabouts. I do hope I can get some useful information out of this.
quests.name: Once a Renowned Doctor

messages: Does #p406# of #m10003000# actually know anything about the whereabouts of that doctor, Niora?�

#b#p406##k of #m10003000# said she couldn't just hand over information for free, but promised to tell me what she knew if I took care of a job request that had just come in. Let's gather #b#t4000024#s#k for her.  \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.#k
I brought #p406# what she'd asked for. Now it's time to hear what she knows.
quests.name: The Price of Information

messages: It seems #p406# of #m10003000# is about to tell me what she knows about Dr. Niora.

I was able to learn a great deal from #p406#. Niora was a doctor of considerable skill, but in the course of practicing medicine, he'd carried out all sorts of experiments on his patients, and patients' conditions had begun worsening at his hospital with increasing frequency. Then, one day, a young girl lost her life — and that was what finally brought Niora under #p411#'s investigation. He was banished from the city and never returned. Which would mean that girl was... I suppose I'd better go see #b#p412##k again. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.#k
I met #p412# and told her everything I'd learned. It seemed she'd finally, however painfully, come to understand that Niora was never coming back to this hospital.
quests.name: A Truth Finally Known

messages: It seems #p900014# at #m10003010# has something to say.

#p900014# at #m10003010#, unlike his brother #p502#, a renowned swordsman, had secretly been doing exorcism work, hunting down evil spirits. He said he could sense the power of a strong evil spirit somewhere around #m10003000#, and suggested that while he investigated elsewhere, I go investigate deep within the subway. If I ran into any #b#o43#s#k down there, it sounded like I'd need to defeat them all. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.#k
I defeated #o43# deep within the #m10003000# subway and went back to #p900014#. Still, there was something serious about the look on his face...
quests.name: A Quiet Line of Work

messages: It seems #p900014# at #m10003010# is still lost in thought.�

#p900014# at #m10003010# said he could still sense the power of a strong evil spirit, and that something didn't seem right. Could it be that even after defeating all those evil spirits in the #m10003000# subway, it still wasn't enough? Just as #p900014# suggested, I should go talk to #p425# at #b#m10003007##k to get more information. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.#k
The moment #p425# at #m10003007# heard the word "evil spirit," she seemed to think of a certain girl...
quests.name: Another Lead

messages: Does #p425# at #m10003007# know anything about the evil spirit somewhere in #m10003000#?

#p425# at #m10003007# couldn't hide the seriousness on her face when I mentioned that #p900014# had been sensing a powerful evil spirit somewhere in #m10003000#. After thinking it over for a while, she said the only one she could think of was the girl at #b#m10003004##k, and asked me to go check on #b#p412##k. Something about this doesn't sit right with me... \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.#k
After some hesitation, I went and met #p412# at #b#m10003004##k. But the girl I hadn't seen in a while... no, the girl's ghost, seemed to know something.
quests.name: A Name She Couldn't Say

names.es: Un nombre que no podía decir

messages: It seems #p412# at #m10003004# looks the same as always.

#p412# at #m10003004# said there was a #bhidden passage#k on the first floor of Niora Hospital, and that she could sense an unusually powerful force coming from somewhere deep inside it, suggesting I go take a look. To think a passage had been hidden away in a place like that... There might be something dangerous down there, so I'd better be well prepared before investigating, and then head back to #p425#. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.#k

Deep within the hidden passage on the first floor of Niora Hospital, I came face to face with a powerful evil spirit. The spirit, named #b#o700006##k, was consumed by such deep resentment that there was no reasoning with it, so I had no choice but to strike it down. Just what on earth happened in this place?
quests.name: An Old Grudge

messages: It seems #p425# at #m10003007# looks somehow relieved.

#p425# at #m10003007# seemed genuinely glad, deep down, that the powerful evil spirit had turned out to be #b#o700006##k, and not #p412#. Still, why had #o700006# come to hold such deep resentment, and just what had happened in that marshland connected to Niora Hospital? Finding the answers to all of this doesn't seem like it'll be easy. It's about time I headed back to #b#p900014##k at #b#m10003010##k.  \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.#k

#p900014# at #m10003010# seemed relieved to hear that the powerful evil spirit, #o700006#, had been defeated, but there was still something about it that seemed to be bothering him. Still, it doesn't seem like there's anything more to find out for now.
quests.name: An Unresolved Question

messages: I've finally been recognized as a #bCitizen of Honor#k of #m10003000#.
It seems #p411#, the city's hidden leader, is looking for me, so I should probably head over right away. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.#k
#p411# at #m10003003# personally congratulated me on becoming a #bCitizen of Honor#k.
quests.name: Becoming a Citizen of Honor

messages: It seems #p411# of #m10003000# has something to tell me now that I've become a #bCitizen of Honor#k.

#p411# of #m10003000# said there was a gift prepared for me for becoming a #bCitizen of Honor#k, but that he'd give it to me once I completed one task. #p411# told me that long ago, not long after he'd first become the Dark Lord, a comrade of his had been kidnapped by a rival faction seeking to seize control of the city, and he entrusted me with the task of finding some clue to his whereabouts. He said the faction most likely responsible for the kidnapping had their hideout deep in the marshland, so I might be able to turn up a clue by defeating #b#o46##k there.  \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.#k
I found #t4031131# in the marshland. Still, deciphering what was written on the document doesn't look like it'll be easy.
quests.name: A Missing Comrade

messages: It seems #p411# at #m10003003# has another task for me.

#p411# at #m10003003# said there was someone who could decipher #b#t4031131##k, and told me to seek out an expert living somewhere deep in the marshland. It sounded like I could find him in a small cabin at #b#m10003097##k.  \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.#k
I met #p436#, an expert in code-breaking, at #m10003098#.
quests.name: An Unbreakable Code

messages: Can #p436# at #m10003098# really decipher #t4031132#?�

#p436# at #m10003098# said #t4031132# had been intricately sealed with magical power, and that deciphering it would require something called #b#t4031133##k. He said #b#o47##k near #b#m10002000##k had it, so it sounded like I'd need to defeat them to get my hands on it.  \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.#k
I brought #p436# at #m10003098# the item needed to decipher #t4031131#.
quests.name: What It Takes

messages: Can #p436# at #m10003098# really decipher #t4031131#?�

#p436# at #m10003098# succeeded in deciphering #t4031132# using #t4031133#. But the look on #p436#'s face darkened as he read over the deciphered document... Anyway, I'd better bring this to #b#p411##k at #m10003000# right away.  \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.#k

I brought #b#t4031135##k to #b#p411##k at #m10003000#. Upon seeing the document, he fell silent for a long moment, having confirmed that Rex, once his comrade and friend, had sacrificed himself for his sake back then... Afterward, he told me I'd carried out the task admirably and handed me a gift. I think every time I look at this #t1032022#, I'll be reminded of #p411# and his friend.
quests.name: The Weight of Truth

messages: It seems #p425# of #m10003007# has an exciting offer for me.
#p425# of #m10003007# said in an excited voice that she had good news, and told me I'd been granted the right to own a house in this town. To hear more details, I should go find #b#p426##k.
#p426# of #m10003007# gruffly told me all about houses.
quests.name: The Right to Own a Home

messages: It seems #p426# of #m10003007# has something more to say about houses.
#p426# of #m10003007# gruffly told me that if I wanted a house, I should go see #b#p427##k. I should be able to find #p427# in the center of #m10003000#.
It seems I can buy a house from #p427# of #m10003000#. I'll have to remember that.
quests.name: Looking for a House

To celebrate the #rGrand Launch#k, the #b#p9010000##k is handing out #bgifts#k.\nA #b#t4031134# might be dropped by #rmonsters Lv. 10 and above#k.

messages: #b#p205##k in #b#m10001000##k says a very old adventure log turned up in the house study.\n\nIt reads like the record of someone who once travelled #bVictoria Island#k, but the middle pages have been torn out, so there is no telling what it really says.

#b#p205##k found a tattered adventure log in the house study, and cannot make head or tail of it.

The middle pages are gone, but the last page still reads:
#e#b"Every hero leaves a mark. But only those who follow the trail will find it."#k#n

A line like that only gets written down over a #rtreasure worth hiding#k. Go and talk to #b#p205##k.
#b#p205##k is sure an adventurer like me can pick the trail back up, and handed over the #b#t2430047##k.\n\nWhatever is left of it, the first page is where this starts.
quests.name: [Event] The Marks We Leave Behind

messages: The first page of the #b#t2430047##k is still legible.\nLet's see what is written on the first page.
The first page of the #b#t2430047##k reads:\n#e#b"Where the sea meets a shore guarded by little snouts."#k#n\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.#k
Wedged in a crack in the rocks at #b#m10000021##k was the next sheet of the log.\nThe #b#t2430048##k is mine. Whoever left this trail meant it to be followed.
quests.name: [Event] The First Mark
quests.demandSummary: Find the secluded shore hidden somewhere on Victoria Island.

messages: The #b#t2430048##k carries a hint about the next place.\r\n\r\nThis one leads #binland#k, away from the shore.
The #b#t2430048##k reads:\n#e#b"I spent one night beneath a stranger's roof."#k#n\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.#k
The monsters of #b#m10001005##k really were holding the next sheet.\n\nThe #b#t2430049##k is mine.
quests.name: [Event] The Second Mark
quests.demandSummary: Search for an unfamiliar dwelling and investigate the area around it.

messages: The #b#t2430049##k carries a hint about the next place.\r\n\r\nThis time the trail runs #binto the trees#k.
The #b#t2430049##k reads:\n#e#b"The forest remembers what the traveler forgets."#k#n\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.#k
High up in #b#m10002004##k, an old tree had kept the next sheet all this time.\r\n\r\nThe #b#t2430050##k is mine.
quests.name: [Event] The Third Mark
quests.demandSummary: Search the high branches deep in the ancient woods.

messages: The #b#t2430050##k carries a hint about the next place.\r\n\r\nThis one comes with a #rwarning#k folded into it.
The #b#t2430050##k reads:\n#e#b"Where shadows gather, leave no coin unturned."#k#n\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.#k
#b10 mesos#k was all the nameless thief ever wanted for it.\r\n\r\nThe #b#t2430051##k is mine. Two pages left.
quests.name: [Event] The Fourth Mark
quests.demandSummary: Search the alleyways for the next trail.

messages: The #b#t2430051##k carries a hint about the next place.\r\n\r\nThis one leads #roff the beaten path#k.
The #b#t2430051##k reads:\n#e#b"Beyond the familiar path, the wild ones roam."#k#n\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.#k
The four scraps line up into a single sheet again.\r\n\r\nThe #b#t2430052##k is mine. #rOne page left!#k
quests.name: [Event] The Fifth Mark
quests.demandSummary: Track down the wild beasts in the rocky lands.

messages: The #b#t2430052##k carries the last hint in the log.\r\n\r\nWhatever the trail was leading to, it ends #runderground#k.
The #b#t2430052##k reads:\n#e#b"Beneath the earth, even the smallest footsteps may lead the way."#k#n\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.#k

Past the hidden portal, at the end of #b#m10005070##k, the trail finally ran out — and the #e#b#t1002994##k#n was lying there waiting.

#e#b"Every hero leaves a mark. But only those who follow the trail will find it."#k#n

So that is what the log meant. The mark is mine now, and the next one is mine to leave.
quests.name: [Event] The Final Mark
quests.demandSummary: Follow the footsteps underground to the final treasure.
